transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we're here for the final review of the voluntary share repurchase program. As Treasury Manager, I have a specific cash constraint I need to put on the table that will directly shape the operating terms. Before I share that, I'd like to hear from legal, tax, and HR on their requirements as well, so we can make sure Elena has everything she needs to authorize the program today.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I've confirmed from the equity plan records this week that only employees with at least 12 months of service may participate in the repurchase program, and any oversubscription must be allocated pro rata rather than on a first-come, first-served priority. I should note that HR has not yet updated the draft enrollment rules to reflect these requirements, but these are binding constraints from the plan records.

This means the final terms must cap cash consideration at exactly $4,230,000 and limit the repurchase to 180,000 shares at the current $23.50 valuation. Elena, this is Treasury's binding cash constraint for the program.
